name: PARDUS 瑞豹 Uragano EVO
why_interesting: A documented 45 mm-clearance electronic 1× gravel build with a 9.65 kg review weight and extensive cargo mounts.

facts.drivetrain: SRAM Apex AXS 1×12 with X1 Eagle AXS rear derailleur; 40T chainring and 11–50T cassette
facts.complete_weight_basis: Biketo review bike without clipless pedals; size and other measurement conditions are not stated
facts.frame: PARDUS HS-grade carbon gravel frame with UDH
facts.frame_material: PARDUS HS high-strength carbon; exact fiber supplier, grade and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: Internal brake/electronic-routing-capable carbon frame with conventional 27.2 mm seatpost and UDH
facts.stiffness_evidence: Biketo ride review describes the frame tuning as on the stiff side on coarse gravel; this is a qualitative ride observation, not a measured stiffness score
facts.tire_clearance_basis: BIKETO's reviewed model states a nominal 700×45C maximum; no rim/tire measured fit protocol.

facts.mounts: Front and rear racks, fenders, three bottle positions and four mounts on each fork leg
